description: This file contains shared helper functions and test cases for diff algorithms, including code snippets in C for comparison, and test logic for a diff tool involving Git repositories.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Runs tests comparing diff outputs between two C source files with different code snippets using the diff tool.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Runs tests comparing diff outputs between two distinct text files with unique content.
